market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $75,000 in May?

assessment.reasoning: BTC ~$78,500. A dip to $75,000 needs only a -4.5% move at any point in 28 days. BTC commonly retests prior support; with consolidation and downside bias, there is a roughly even-to-favorable chance of touching $75k on a 1-min low.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether buyers defend $76-77k support without a deeper flush.
